title: Lung fibroblasts contribute to release of serum amyloid A as potential biomarker of exacerbation of lung fibrosis in mice.
snippet: Fibroblasts are important contributors to collagen deposition in interstitial lung diseases (ILD), but their inflammatory role in acute exacerbation of ILD including idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis is currently undefined.
